title: PackageVersion
description: Immutable SCORM or cmi5 package profile, source bytes and validated manifest projection.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

institution_id.description: Institution owning these data and their access policy.
institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

artifact_id.description: Archive bytes accepted for the owning trust boundary.
artifact_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

edition.description: Exact standard edition declared and validated.

schema_build.description: Immutable schema bundle and compatibility policy version.

network_allowlist.description: Exact reviewed origins the content execution may reach.

reviewer_principal_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

x-invariants: A byte or validated manifest change creates a new version.
Approval is separately scoped and does not activate a course assignment.
Existing registrations retain the assigned package digest.
